title: Arrow Path: one helper for the 🔁 picture
body:
A small tidy-up in Arrow Path's screen code. Nothing changes in how the game looks or plays.

## What changed
- `games/arrow-path/view.js`: the 🔁 picture with its ×2 or ×3 count was built in two places (the move slots and the keys) with the same 5 lines. It's now one small `loopIcon` function, used by both. The elements, their classes and the labels screen readers hear are exactly the same as before.

## How to try it
`node tests/serve.mjs`, open `http://localhost:4173/logic-lane/`, Arrow Path → Medium, and play up to level 14 (or long-press the level to check it): the 🔁×2 and 🔁×3 keys and slots look and work as before.

## Checks
- The Arrow Path browser tests and accessibility checks cover the 🔁 keys and slots.
- Local `npm run check`: type check passed, 378 unit tests passed, 183 browser tests passed. Visual snapshots skipped locally (they run only on GitHub); no picture should change.
- No decisions changed. No packages added or upgraded.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
why: A pure refactor inside a game's view: same DOM, classes and aria-labels, JSDoc-typed helper, no logic, storage, path, input or generator change.
